criteria: investigation determines whether the dashboard recent-activity feed is expected to show an awaiting-confirmation item and whether it currently surfaces one via DECISION_PACKET_CREATED or the DecisionPacket update CDC

if a real gap is confirmed, the signal is sourced from the DecisionPacket AWAITING_CONFIRMATION status via the existing row CDC (an investor-adpt-forwarded DecisionPacket-status event or a dashboard-bff projection on the existing decision row), never from the removed dead event
dashboard-bff unit and integration suites remain green and the removed USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUESTED handler is not reintroduced
excluded_paths: docs/backlog/** (planning authority; no write-back from Level 3)
immutable_paths: every pre-existing tracked byte of the Nestfolio repository at the pinned source revision
include_paths: services/investor/dashboard-bff/** (activity-feed read model, handlers, tests, service card)
services/investor/investor-adpt/** (only if the chosen sourcing forwards a DecisionPacket-status event cross-domain)
services/advisory/decision-workflow-ctrl/src/service.stack.ts (read-only reference for the DecisionPacket CDC contract)
non_goals: reintroducing the removed USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUESTED event or its dead handler
changing the L2 confirmation UX beyond the activity feed
producer-side DecisionPacket changes beyond what the chosen sourcing strictly requires
outputs: recorded investigation result: expected versus actual recent-activity behavior for L2 AWAITING_CONFIRMATION decisions
if the gap is real: a dashboard-bff read-model change sourcing the awaiting-confirmation activity item from DecisionPacket status CDC
tests covering the new projection path plus updated service card and backlog record on ship
permitted_effects: dashboard-bff read-model projection/subscription changes within include paths
test additions for the new projection path
service card and backlog record updates on ship
prohibited_effects: no mutation of any excluded or immutable path
validation_requirements: dashboard-bff unit and integration suites green
activity-feed behavior verified against the real DecisionPacket CDC emission per the project's validate-against-real-emission discipline
